```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.governance.service.impl;

import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.governance.service.PromptService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.PromptDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.PromptValidationDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.PromptVersionDto;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.retry.RetryOperator;
import io.github.resilience4j.retry.Retry;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Implementación reactiva del servicio Prompts con resiliencia.
 *
 * Este servicio:
 * 1. Llama al microservicio de Prompts con circuit breakers y retry
 * 2. Agrega datos de múltiples fuentes cuando sea necesario
 * 3. Proporciona respuestas optimizadas para el frontend
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
public class PromptServiceImpl implements PromptService {

    private final WebClient webClient;
    private final CircuitBreaker promptsServiceCircuitBreaker;
    private final Retry promptsServiceRetry;

    public PromptServiceImpl(
            WebClient webClient,
            @Qualifier("promptsServiceCircuitBreaker") CircuitBreaker promptsServiceCircuitBreaker,
            @Qualifier("promptsServiceRetry") Retry promptsServiceRetry) {
        this.webClient = webClient;
        this.promptsServiceCircuitBreaker = promptsServiceCircuitBreaker;
        this.promptsServiceRetry = promptsServiceRetry;
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptDto> registerPrompt(PromptDto request) {
        log.info("Registrando nuevo prompt: name={}", request.getPrmname());
        return webClient.post()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/register")
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error registrando prompt", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptDto> getPrompt(Long promptId) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo prompt: promptId={}", promptId);
        return webClient.get()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/{promptId}", promptId)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error obteniendo prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptListResponseDto> listPrompts(int page, int size, Long projectId, 
                                                  String status, String search) {
        log.debug("Listando prompts: page={}, size={}, projectId={}, status={}", page, size, projectId, status);
        StringBuilder uri = new StringBuilder("/api/v1/prompts?page=").append(page).append("&size=").append(size);
        if (projectId != null) uri.append("&projectId=").append(projectId);
        if (status != null) uri.append("&status=").append(status);
        if (search != null) uri.append("&search=").append(search);

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(uri.toString())
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptListResponseDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error listando prompts", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptVersionDto> createVersion(Long promptId, PromptVersionDto request) {
        log.info("Creando nueva versión de prompt: promptId={}, version={}", promptId, request.getPrmversion());
        return webClient.post()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions", promptId)
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptVersionDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error creando versión: promptId={}", promptId, error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<List<PromptVersionDto>> getVersions(Long promptId) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo versiones de prompt: promptId={}", promptId);
        return webClient.get()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions", promptId)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToFlux(PromptVersionDto.class)
                .collectList()
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error obteniendo versiones: promptId={}", promptId, error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Map<String, Object>> getVersioningOverview(int page, int size,
                                                            String search, String status) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo overview de versioning: page={}, size={}", page, size);
        StringBuilder uri = new StringBuilder("/api/v1/prompts/versioning/overview?page=")
                .append(page).append("&size=").append(size);
        if (search != null) uri.append("&search=").append(search);
        if (status != null) uri.append("&status=").append(status);

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(uri.toString())
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(Map.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error obteniendo overview de versioning", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptValidationDto> createValidation(Long promptId, PromptValidationDto request) {
        log.info("Creando validación de prompt: promptId={}", promptId);
        return webClient.post()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations", promptId)
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptValidationDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error creando validación: promptId={}", promptId, error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<List<PromptValidationDto>> getValidations(Long promptId) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo validaciones de prompt: promptId={}", promptId);
        return webClient.get()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations", promptId)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToFlux(PromptValidationDto.class)
                .collectList()
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error obteniendo validaciones: promptId={}", promptId, error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Map<String, Object>> getValidationOverview(int page, int size,
                                                             String search, String validationType,
                                                             String status) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo overview de validación: page={}, size={}", page, size);
        StringBuilder uri = new StringBuilder("/api/v1/prompts/validation/overview?page=")
                .append(page).append("&size=").append(size);
        if (search != null) uri.append("&search=").append(search);
        if (validationType != null) uri.append("&validationType=").append(validationType);
        if (status != null) uri.append("&status=").append(status);

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(uri.toString())
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(Map.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error obteniendo overview de validación", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Map<String, Object>> getPerformanceOverview(int page, int size, String search) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo overview de performance: page={}, size={}", page, size);
        StringBuilder uri = new StringBuilder("/api/v1/prompts/templates/performance?page=")
                .append(page).append("&size=").append(size);
        if (search != null) uri.append("&search=").append(search);

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(uri.toString())
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(Map.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error obteniendo overview de performance", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptDto> updatePrompt(Long promptId, PromptDto request) {
        log.info("Actualizando prompt: promptId={}", promptId);
        return webClient.put()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/{promptId}", promptId)
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error actualizando prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> deletePrompt(Long promptId) {
        log.info("Eliminando prompt: promptId={}", promptId);
        return webClient.delete()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/{promptId}", promptId)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(Void.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error eliminando prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error));
    }
}

package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.governance.service.impl;

import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.governance.service.PromptService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.*;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.retry.RetryOperator;
import io.github.resilience4j.retry.Retry;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Implementación reactiva del servicio Prompts con resiliencia.
 *
 * Este servicio:
 * 1. Llama al microservicio de Prompts con circuit breakers y retry
 * 2. Agrega datos de múltiples fuentes cuando sea necesario
 * 3. Proporciona respuestas optimizadas para el frontend
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
public class PromptServiceImpl implements PromptService {

    private final WebClient webClient;
    private final CircuitBreaker promptsServiceCircuitBreaker;
    private final Retry promptsServiceRetry;

    public PromptServiceImpl(
            WebClient webClient,
            @Qualifier("promptsServiceCircuitBreaker") CircuitBreaker promptsServiceCircuitBreaker,
            @Qualifier("promptsServiceRetry") Retry promptsServiceRetry) {
        this.webClient = webClient;
        this.promptsServiceCircuitBreaker = promptsServiceCircuitBreaker;
        this.promptsServiceRetry = promptsServiceRetry;
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptDto> registerPrompt(PromptDto request) {
        log.info("Registrando nuevo prompt: name={}", request.getPrmname());
        return webClient.post()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/register")
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error registrando prompt", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptDto> getPrompt(Long promptId) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo prompt: promptId={}", promptId);
        return webClient.get()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/{promptId}", promptId)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error obteniendo prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptListResponseDto> listPrompts(int page, int size, Long projectId, 
                                                  String status, String search) {
        log.debug("Listando prompts: page={}, size={}, projectId={}, status={}", page, size, projectId, status);
        StringBuilder uri = new StringBuilder("/api/v1/prompts?page=").append(page).append("&size=").append(size);
        if (projectId != null) uri.append("&projectId=").append(projectId);
        if (status != null) uri.append("&status=").append(status);
        if (search != null) uri.append("&search=").append(search);

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(uri.toString())
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptListResponseDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error listando prompts", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<PromptVersionDto> createVersion(Long promptId, PromptVersionDto request) {
        log.info("Creando nueva versión de prompt: promptId={}, version={}", promptId, request.getPrmversion());
        return webClient.post()
                .uri("/api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions", promptId)
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(PromptVersionDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(promptsServiceRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error creando versión: promptId={}", promptId, error));
    }

        return webClient.get()

                .bodyToFlux(PromptVersionDto.class)
                .collectList()
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(promptsServiceCircuitBreaker))

                .append(page).append("&size=").append(size);

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.governance.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.governance.service.PromptService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.PromptDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.PromptValidationDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.PromptVersionDto;
import io.micrometer.core.annotation.Timed;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Controller reactivo para Prompts.
 *
 * Este controller actúa como BFF, agregando datos de múltiples microservicios
 * y proporcionando endpoints optimizados para el frontend.
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/register - Registrar nuevo prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Obtener detalle de prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts - Listar prompts con paginación
 * - PUT /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Actualizar prompt
 * - DELETE /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Eliminar prompt
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Crear nueva versión
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Obtener versiones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/versioning/overview - Overview de versioning
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Crear validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Obtener validaciones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/validation/overview - Overview de validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/templates/performance - Overview de performance
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/prompts")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Tag(name = "Prompts", description = "Gobernanza de prompts de IA")
@Timed(value = "governance.prompts.controller", description = "Métricas del controller Prompts")
public class PromptController {

    private final PromptService promptService;

    @PostMapping("/register")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Registrar nuevo prompt",
            description = "Registra un nuevo prompt de IA asociado a un proyecto."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt registrado exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    @Timed(value = "governance.prompts.register", description = "Tiempo de registro de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> registerPrompt(
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto request) {

        log.info("Registrando nuevo prompt: name={}", request.getPrmname());

        return promptService.registerPrompt(request)
                .map(response -> {
                    log.info("Prompt registrado: promptId={}, name={}",
                            response.getIdxprompt(), response.getPrmname());
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error registrando prompt", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Obtener detalle de prompt")
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt encontrado",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Prompt no encontrado")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> getPrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return promptService.getPrompt(promptId)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error obteniendo prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(summary = "Listar prompts con paginación")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptListResponseDto>> listPrompts(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {

        log.debug("Listando prompts: page={}, size={}, projectId={}, status={}", 
                page, size, projectId, status);

        return promptService.listPrompts(page, size, projectId, status, search)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error listando prompts", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PutMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Actualizar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> updatePrompt(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto request) {

        log.info("Actualizando prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return promptService.updatePrompt(promptId, request)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error actualizando prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Eliminar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> deletePrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Eliminando prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return promptService.deletePrompt(promptId)
                .then(Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok().<Void>build()))
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error eliminando prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{promptId}/versions")
    @Operation(summary = "Crear nueva versión de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptVersionDto>> createVersion(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptVersionDto request) {

        log.info("Creando versión de prompt: promptId={}, version={}",
                promptId, request.getPrmversion());

        return promptService.createVersion(promptId, request)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error creando versión: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}/versions")
    @Operation(summary = "Obtener versiones de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<PromptVersionDto>>> getVersions(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo versiones: promptId={}", promptId);

        return promptService.getVersions(promptId)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error obteniendo versiones: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/versioning/overview")
    @Operation(summary = "Overview de versioning de prompts")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>>> getVersioningOverview(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status) {

        log.debug("Obteniendo overview de versioning: page={}, size={}", page, size);

        return promptService.getVersioningOverview(page, size, search, status)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error obteniendo overview de versioning", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{promptId}/validations")
    @Operation(summary = "Crear validación de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptValidationDto>> createValidation(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptValidationDto request) {

        log.info("Creando validación: promptId={}", promptId);

        return promptService.createValidation(promptId, request)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error creando validación: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}/validations")

            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    @Timed(value = "governance.prompts.register", description = "Tiempo de registro de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> registerPrompt(
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto request) {

        log.info("Registrando nuevo prompt: name={}", request.getPrmname());

        return promptService.registerPrompt(request)
                .map(response -> {
                    log.info("Prompt registrado: promptId={}, name={}",
                            response.getIdxprompt(), response.getPrmname());
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error registrando prompt", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());

@Slf4j

public class PromptController {

    @PostMapping("/register")

            summary = "Registrar nuevo prompt",

                .map(response -> {
                    log.info("Prompt registrado: promptId={}, name={}",
                            response.getIdxprompt(), response.getPrmname());
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(response);

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.prompts.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.prompts.PromptBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.Prompt;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.PromptValidation;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.PromptVersion;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para operaciones de gobernanza de prompts.
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/register - Registrar nuevo prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Obtener detalle de prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts - Listar prompts con paginación
 * - PUT /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Actualizar prompt
 * - DELETE /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Eliminar prompt
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Crear nueva versión
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Obtener versiones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/versioning/overview - Overview de versioning
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Crear validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Obtener validaciones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/validation/overview - Overview de validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/templates/performance - Overview de performance
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/prompts")
@Tag(name = "Prompts", description = "Operaciones para gobernanza de prompts de IA")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PromptController {

    private final PromptBusinessService promptBusinessService;

    @PostMapping("/register")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Registrar nuevo prompt",
            description = "Registra un nuevo prompt de IA asociado a un proyecto."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt registrado exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> registerPrompt(
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to register prompt: name={}", dto.getPrmname());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                Prompt entity = toEntity(dto);
                Prompt saved = promptBusinessService.save(entity);
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toDto(saved);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error registering prompt", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Obtener detalle de prompt")
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt encontrado",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Prompt no encontrado")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> getPrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to get prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> promptBusinessService.findById(promptId))
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .flatMap(prompt -> {
                if (prompt == null) {
                    log.warn("Prompt not found: {}", promptId);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PromptDto>notFound().build());
                }
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok(toDto(prompt)));
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error retrieving prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PromptDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(summary = "Listar prompts con paginación")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>>> listPrompts(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {

        log.info("Request to list prompts: page={}, size={}, projectId={}, status={}",
                page, size, projectId, status);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<Prompt> prompts = promptBusinessService.findAll(page, size, projectId, status, search);
                List<PromptDto> dtos = prompts.stream()
                    .map(this::toDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

                Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
                response.put("items", dtos);
                response.put("page", page);
                response.put("size", size);
                response.put("total", promptBusinessService.count(projectId, status, search));
                return response;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error listing prompts", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PutMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Actualizar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> updatePrompt(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to update prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                Prompt existing = promptBusinessService.findById(promptId);
                if (existing == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Prompt not found: " + promptId);
                }
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                Prompt entity = toEntity(dto);
                entity.setIdxprompt(promptId);
                Prompt saved = promptBusinessService.save(entity);
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toDto(saved);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Eliminar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> deletePrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to delete prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                promptBusinessService.delete(promptId);
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .then(Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok().<Void>build()))
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error deleting prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{promptId}/versions")
    @Operation(summary = "Crear nueva versión de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptVersionDto>> createVersion(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptVersionDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to create version: promptId={}, version={}",
                promptId, dto.getPrmversion());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                PromptVersion entity = toVersionEntity(dto, promptId);

            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error creating version: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    private PromptDto toDto(Prompt entity) {
        PromptDto dto = new PromptDto();
        dto.setIdxprompt(entity.getIdxprompt());
        dto.setPrmname(entity.getPrmname());
        dto.setPrmdescription(entity.getPrmdescription());
        dto.setPrmtype(entity.getPrmtype());
        dto.setPrmcategory(entity.getPrmcategory());
        dto.setPrmversion(entity.getPrmversion());
        dto.setPrmstatus(entity.getPrmstatus());
        dto.setPrmcontent(entity.getPrmcontent());
        dto.setPrmparameters(entity.getPrmparameters());
        dto.setPrmmetadata(entity.getPrmmetadata());
        dto.setPrmapprovalstatus(entity.getPrmapprovalstatus());
        dto.setPrmapprovedby(entity.getPrmapprovedby());
        if (entity.getPrmapprovedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmapprovedat(entity.getPrmapprovedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setPrmcreatedby(entity.getPrmcreatedby());
        dto.setPrmupdatedby(entity.getPrmupdatedby());
        if (entity.getPrmcreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmcreatedat(entity.getPrmcreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        if (entity.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmupdatedat(entity.getPrmupdatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private Prompt toEntity(PromptDto dto) {
        Prompt entity = new Prompt();
        if (dto.getIdxprompt() != null) {
            entity.setIdxprompt(dto.getIdxprompt());
        }
        entity.setPrmname(dto.getPrmname());
        entity.setPrmdescription(dto.getPrmdescription());
        entity.setPrmtype(dto.getPrmtype());
        entity.setPrmcategory(dto.getPrmcategory());
        entity.setPrmversion(dto.getPrmversion());
        entity.setPrmstatus(dto.getPrmstatus());
        entity.setPrmcontent(dto.getPrmcontent());
        entity.setPrmparameters(dto.getPrmparameters());
        entity.setPrmmetadata(dto.getPrmmetadata());
        entity.setPrmapprovalstatus(dto.getPrmapprovalstatus());
        entity.setPrmapprovedby(dto.getPrmapprovedby());
        if (dto.getPrmapprovedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmapprovedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmapprovedat()));
        }
        entity.setPrmcreatedby(dto.getPrmcreatedby());
        entity.setPrmupdatedby(dto.getPrmupdatedby());
        if (dto.getPrmcreatedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmcreatedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmcreatedat()));
        } else {
            entity.setPrmcreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        }
        if (dto.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmupdatedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmupdatedat()));
        }
        return entity;
    }

        }
        if (entity.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.prompts.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.prompts.PromptBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.Prompt;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.PromptValidation;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.PromptVersion;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para operaciones de gobernanza de prompts.
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/register - Registrar nuevo prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Obtener detalle de prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts - Listar prompts con paginación
 * - PUT /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Actualizar prompt
 * - DELETE /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Eliminar prompt
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Crear nueva versión
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Obtener versiones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/versioning/overview - Overview de versioning
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Crear validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Obtener validaciones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/validation/overview - Overview de validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/templates/performance - Overview de performance
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/prompts")
@Tag(name = "Prompts", description = "Operaciones para gobernanza de prompts de IA")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PromptController {

    private final PromptBusinessService promptBusinessService;

    @PostMapping("/register")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Registrar nuevo prompt",
            description = "Registra un nuevo prompt de IA asociado a un proyecto."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt registrado exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> registerPrompt(
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to register prompt: name={}", dto.getPrmname());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                Prompt entity = toEntity(dto);
                Prompt saved = promptBusinessService.save(entity);
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toDto(saved);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error registering prompt", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Obtener detalle de prompt")
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt encontrado",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Prompt no encontrado")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> getPrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to get prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> promptBusinessService.findById(promptId))
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .flatMap(prompt -> {
                if (prompt == null) {
                    log.warn("Prompt not found: {}", promptId);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PromptDto>notFound().build());
                }
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok(toDto(prompt)));
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error retrieving prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PromptDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(summary = "Listar prompts con paginación")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>>> listPrompts(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {

        log.info("Request to list prompts: page={}, size={}, projectId={}, status={}",
                page, size, projectId, status);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<Prompt> prompts = promptBusinessService.findAll(page, size, projectId, status, search);
                List<PromptDto> dtos = prompts.stream()
                    .map(this::toDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

                Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
                response.put("items", dtos);
                response.put("page", page);
                response.put("size", size);
                response.put("total", promptBusinessService.count(projectId, status, search));
                return response;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error listing prompts", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PutMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Actualizar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> updatePrompt(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to update prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                Prompt existing = promptBusinessService.findById(promptId);
                if (existing == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Prompt not found: " + promptId);
                }
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                Prompt entity = toEntity(dto);
                entity.setIdxprompt(promptId);
                Prompt saved = promptBusinessService.save(entity);
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toDto(saved);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Eliminar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> deletePrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to delete prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                promptBusinessService.delete(promptId);
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .then(Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok().<Void>build()))
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error deleting prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{promptId}/versions")
    @Operation(summary = "Crear nueva versión de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptVersionDto>> createVersion(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,

        log.info("Request to create version: promptId={}, version={}",
                promptId, dto.getPrmversion());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                PromptVersion entity = toVersionEntity(dto, promptId);

            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error creating version: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });

    private PromptDto toDto(Prompt entity) {
        PromptDto dto = new PromptDto();
        dto.setIdxprompt(entity.getIdxprompt());
        dto.setPrmname(entity.getPrmname());
        dto.setPrmdescription(entity.getPrmdescription());
        dto.setPrmtype(entity.getPrmtype());
        dto.setPrmcategory(entity.getPrmcategory());
        dto.setPrmversion(entity.getPrmversion());
        dto.setPrmstatus(entity.getPrmstatus());
        dto.setPrmcontent(entity.getPrmcontent());
        dto.setPrmparameters(entity.getPrmparameters());
        dto.setPrmmetadata(entity.getPrmmetadata());
        dto.setPrmapprovalstatus(entity.getPrmapprovalstatus());
        dto.setPrmapprovedby(entity.getPrmapprovedby());
        if (entity.getPrmapprovedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmapprovedat(entity.getPrmapprovedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setPrmcreatedby(entity.getPrmcreatedby());
        dto.setPrmupdatedby(entity.getPrmupdatedby());
        if (entity.getPrmcreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmcreatedat(entity.getPrmcreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        if (entity.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmupdatedat(entity.getPrmupdatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private Prompt toEntity(PromptDto dto) {
        Prompt entity = new Prompt();
        if (dto.getIdxprompt() != null) {
            entity.setIdxprompt(dto.getIdxprompt());
        }
        entity.setPrmname(dto.getPrmname());
        entity.setPrmdescription(dto.getPrmdescription());
        entity.setPrmtype(dto.getPrmtype());
        entity.setPrmcategory(dto.getPrmcategory());
        entity.setPrmversion(dto.getPrmversion());
        entity.setPrmstatus(dto.getPrmstatus());
        entity.setPrmcontent(dto.getPrmcontent());
        entity.setPrmparameters(dto.getPrmparameters());
        entity.setPrmmetadata(dto.getPrmmetadata());
        entity.setPrmapprovalstatus(dto.getPrmapprovalstatus());
        entity.setPrmapprovedby(dto.getPrmapprovedby());
        if (dto.getPrmapprovedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmapprovedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmapprovedat()));
        }
        entity.setPrmcreatedby(dto.getPrmcreatedby());
        entity.setPrmupdatedby(dto.getPrmupdatedby());
        if (dto.getPrmcreatedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmcreatedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmcreatedat()));
        } else {
            entity.setPrmcreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        }
        if (dto.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmupdatedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmupdatedat()));
        }
        return entity;
    }

    private PromptVersionDto toVersionDto(PromptVersion entity) {
        PromptVersionDto dto = new PromptVersionDto();
        dto.setIdxpromptversion(entity.getIdxpromptversion());
        dto.setPrmversion(entity.getPrmversion());

        dto.setPrmparameters(entity.getPrmparameters());

        }
        if (entity.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmupdatedat(entity.getPrmupdatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

        }

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.prompts.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.prompts.PromptBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.Prompt;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.PromptValidation;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.PromptVersion;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para operaciones de gobernanza de prompts.
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/register - Registrar nuevo prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Obtener detalle de prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts - Listar prompts con paginación
 * - PUT /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Actualizar prompt
 * - DELETE /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Eliminar prompt
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Crear nueva versión
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Obtener versiones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/versioning/overview - Overview de versioning
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Crear validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Obtener validaciones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/validation/overview - Overview de validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/templates/performance - Overview de performance
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/prompts")
@Tag(name = "Prompts", description = "Operaciones para gobernanza de prompts de IA")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PromptController {

    private final PromptBusinessService promptBusinessService;

    @PostMapping("/register")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Registrar nuevo prompt",
            description = "Registra un nuevo prompt de IA asociado a un proyecto."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt registrado exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> registerPrompt(
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to register prompt: name={}", dto.getPrmname());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                Prompt entity = toEntity(dto);
                Prompt saved = promptBusinessService.save(entity);
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toDto(saved);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error registering prompt", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Obtener detalle de prompt")
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt encontrado",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Prompt no encontrado")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> getPrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to get prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> promptBusinessService.findById(promptId))
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .flatMap(prompt -> {
                if (prompt == null) {
                    log.warn("Prompt not found: {}", promptId);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PromptDto>notFound().build());
                }
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok(toDto(prompt)));
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error retrieving prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PromptDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(summary = "Listar prompts con paginación")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptListResponseDto>> listPrompts(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {

        log.info("Request to list prompts: page={}, size={}, projectId={}, status={}", 
                page, size, projectId, status);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<Prompt> prompts = promptBusinessService.findAll(page, size, projectId, status, search);
                List<PromptDto> dtos = prompts.stream()
                    .map(this::toDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
                
                Long total = promptBusinessService.count(projectId, status, search);
                int totalPages = (int) Math.ceil((double) total / size);
                
                return PromptListResponseDto.builder()
                    .items(dtos)
                    .page(page)
                    .size(size)
                    .total(total)
                    .totalPages(totalPages)
                    .build();
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error listing prompts", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PutMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Actualizar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> updatePrompt(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to update prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                Prompt existing = promptBusinessService.findById(promptId);
                if (existing == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Prompt not found: " + promptId);
                }
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                Prompt entity = toEntity(dto);
                entity.setIdxprompt(promptId);
                Prompt saved = promptBusinessService.save(entity);
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toDto(saved);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Eliminar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> deletePrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to delete prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                promptBusinessService.delete(promptId);
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .then(Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok().<Void>build()))
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error deleting prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{promptId}/versions")
    @Operation(summary = "Crear nueva versión de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptVersionDto>> createVersion(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptVersionDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to create version: promptId={}, version={}",
                promptId, dto.getPrmversion());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                PromptVersion entity = toVersionEntity(dto, promptId);
                PromptVersion saved = promptBusinessService.saveVersion(entity);
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toVersionDto(saved);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {

    private PromptDto toDto(Prompt entity) {
        PromptDto dto = new PromptDto();
        dto.setIdxprompt(entity.getIdxprompt());
        dto.setPrmname(entity.getPrmname());
        dto.setPrmdescription(entity.getPrmdescription());
        dto.setPrmtype(entity.getPrmtype());
        dto.setPrmcategory(entity.getPrmcategory());
        dto.setPrmversion(entity.getPrmversion());
        dto.setPrmstatus(entity.getPrmstatus());
        dto.setPrmcontent(entity.getPrmcontent());
        dto.setPrmparameters(entity.getPrmparameters());
        dto.setPrmmetadata(entity.getPrmmetadata());
        dto.setPrmapprovalstatus(entity.getPrmapprovalstatus());
        dto.setPrmapprovedby(entity.getPrmapprovedby());
        if (entity.getPrmapprovedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmapprovedat(entity.getPrmapprovedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setPrmcreatedby(entity.getPrmcreatedby());
        dto.setPrmupdatedby(entity.getPrmupdatedby());
        if (entity.getPrmcreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmcreatedat(entity.getPrmcreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        if (entity.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmupdatedat(entity.getPrmupdatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private Prompt toEntity(PromptDto dto) {
        Prompt entity = new Prompt();
        if (dto.getIdxprompt() != null) {
            entity.setIdxprompt(dto.getIdxprompt());
        }
        entity.setPrmname(dto.getPrmname());
        entity.setPrmdescription(dto.getPrmdescription());
        entity.setPrmtype(dto.getPrmtype());
        entity.setPrmcategory(dto.getPrmcategory());
        entity.setPrmversion(dto.getPrmversion());
        entity.setPrmstatus(dto.getPrmstatus());
        entity.setPrmcontent(dto.getPrmcontent());
        entity.setPrmparameters(dto.getPrmparameters());
        entity.setPrmmetadata(dto.getPrmmetadata());
        entity.setPrmapprovalstatus(dto.getPrmapprovalstatus());
        entity.setPrmapprovedby(dto.getPrmapprovedby());
        if (dto.getPrmapprovedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmapprovedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmapprovedat()));
        }
        entity.setPrmcreatedby(dto.getPrmcreatedby());
        entity.setPrmupdatedby(dto.getPrmupdatedby());
        if (dto.getPrmcreatedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmcreatedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmcreatedat()));
        } else {
            entity.setPrmcreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        }
        if (dto.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmupdatedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmupdatedat()));
        }
        return entity;
    }

        PromptVersionDto dto = new PromptVersionDto();
        dto.setIdxpromptversion(entity.getIdxpromptversion());
        dto.setPrmversion(entity.getPrmversion());

        }
        if (entity.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmupdatedat(entity.getPrmupdatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
