```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.prompts.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.prompts.PromptBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.*;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.prompts.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para operaciones de gobernanza de prompts.
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/register - Registrar nuevo prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Obtener detalle de prompt
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts - Listar prompts con paginación
 * - PUT /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Actualizar prompt
 * - DELETE /api/v1/prompts/{promptId} - Eliminar prompt
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Crear nueva versión
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/versions - Obtener versiones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/versioning/overview - Overview de versioning
 * - POST /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Crear validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/{promptId}/validations - Obtener validaciones
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/validation/overview - Overview de validación
 * - GET /api/v1/prompts/templates/performance - Overview de performance
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/prompts")
@Tag(name = "Prompts", description = "Operaciones para gobernanza de prompts de IA")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PromptController {

    private final PromptBusinessService promptBusinessService;

    @PostMapping("/register")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Registrar nuevo prompt",
            description = "Registra un nuevo prompt de IA asociado a un proyecto."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt registrado exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> registerPrompt(
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to register prompt: name={}", dto.getPrmname());

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                Prompt entity = toEntity(dto);
                Prompt saved = promptBusinessService.save(entity);
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toDto(saved);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error registering prompt", error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST)
                        .body((PromptDto) null)); // El mensaje se puede manejar en el frontend
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Obtener detalle de prompt")
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Prompt encontrado",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = PromptDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Prompt no encontrado")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> getPrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to get prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> promptBusinessService.findById(promptId))
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .flatMap(prompt -> {
                if (prompt == null) {
                    log.warn("Prompt not found: {}", promptId);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PromptDto>notFound().build());
                }
                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok(toDto(prompt)));
            })
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error retrieving prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<PromptDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(summary = "Listar prompts con paginación")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptListResponseDto>> listPrompts(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {

        log.info("Request to list prompts: page={}, size={}, projectId={}, status={}",
                page, size, projectId, status);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<Prompt> prompts = promptBusinessService.findAll(page, size, projectId, status, search);
                List<PromptDto> dtos = prompts.stream()
                    .map(this::toDto)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

                Long total = promptBusinessService.count(projectId, status, search);
                int totalPages = (int) Math.ceil((double) total / size);

                return PromptListResponseDto.builder()
                    .items(dtos)
                    .page(page)
                    .size(size)
                    .total(total)
                    .totalPages(totalPages)
                    .build();
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error listing prompts", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PutMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Actualizar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptDto>> updatePrompt(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to update prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                Prompt existing = promptBusinessService.findById(promptId);
                if (existing == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Prompt not found: " + promptId);
                }

                // ✅ Convertir DTO a entidad antes de llamar al servicio
                Prompt entity = toEntity(dto);
                entity.setIdxprompt(promptId);

                // Verificar si el contenido cambió
                boolean contentChanged = !existing.getPrmcontent().equals(entity.getPrmcontent());

                if (contentChanged) {
                    // Si el contenido cambió, crear nueva versión automáticamente
                    log.info("Content changed for prompt {}, creating new version automatically", promptId);
                    String changes = dto.getPrmchanges() != null ? dto.getPrmchanges() : "Actualización automática: contenido modificado";
                    promptBusinessService.createNewVersionFromPrompt(entity, changes);
                    // Retornar el prompt actualizado
                    Prompt updated = promptBusinessService.findById(promptId);
                    return toDto(updated);
                } else {
                    // Si solo cambió metadata, actualizar sin crear versión
                    Prompt saved = promptBusinessService.updateMetadata(entity);
                    return toDto(saved);
                }
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error updating prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{promptId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Eliminar prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> deletePrompt(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to delete prompt: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                promptBusinessService.delete(promptId);
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .then(Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok().<Void>build()))
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error deleting prompt: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{promptId}/versions")
    @Operation(summary = "Crear nueva versión de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptVersionDto>> createVersion(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @Valid @RequestBody PromptVersionDto dto) {

        log.info("Request to create version: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                Prompt existing = promptBusinessService.findById(promptId);
                if (existing == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Prompt not found: " + promptId);
                }

                // Si no se proporciona versión, generar automáticamente
                if (dto.getPrmversion() == null || dto.getPrmversion().isEmpty()) {
                    String nextVersion = generateNextVersion(existing.getPrmversion());
                    dto.setPrmversion(nextVersion);
                }

                // Crear entidad Prompt con los datos del DTO para crear la versión
                Prompt promptForVersion = new Prompt();
                promptForVersion.setIdxprompt(promptId);
                promptForVersion.setPrmdescription(dto.getPrmdescription());
                promptForVersion.setPrmcontent(dto.getPrmcontent());
                promptForVersion.setPrmparameters(dto.getPrmparameters());
                promptForVersion.setPrmstatus(dto.getPrmstatus());
                promptForVersion.setPrmcreatedby(dto.getPrmcreatedby());

                // Crear nueva versión
                String changes = dto.getPrmchanges() != null ? dto.getPrmchanges() : "Nueva versión creada manualmente";
                PromptVersion saved = promptBusinessService.createNewVersionFromPrompt(promptForVersion, changes);

                // ✅ Convertir entidad a DTO antes de retornar
                return toVersionDto(saved);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error creating version: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    /**
     * Genera la versión siguiente basándose en la versión actual.
     */
    private String generateNextVersion(String currentVersion) {
        if (currentVersion == null || currentVersion.isEmpty()) {
            return "1.0.0";
        }

        try {
            String[] parts = currentVersion.split("\\.");
            if (parts.length >= 2) {
                int major = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
                int minor = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
                int patch = parts.length > 2 ? Integer.parseInt(parts[2]) : 0;

                minor++;
                patch = 0;

                return major + "." + minor + "." + patch;
            } else {
                return "1.0.0";
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            log.warn("Error parsing version: {}, using default 1.0.0", currentVersion);
            return "1.0.0";
        }
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}/versions")
    @Operation(summary = "Obtener versiones de prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<PromptVersionDto>>> getVersions(@PathVariable Long promptId) {

                Long total = promptBusinessService.countVersions(search, status);

                // Métricas
                PromptVersioningMetricsDto metrics = PromptVersioningMetricsDto.builder()

                return PromptVersioningOverviewResponseDto.builder()

            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())

                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());

            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .then(Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok().<Void>build()))
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error disassociating model: promptId={}, modelId={}", promptId, modelId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}/models")
    @Operation(summary = "Obtener Models asociados a un Prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<PromptRelationDto>>> getAssociatedModels(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to get associated models: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<PromptModel> promptModels = promptBusinessService.getAssociatedModels(promptId);
                return promptModels.stream()
                    .map(pm -> toRelationDto(pm, "MODEL"))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting associated models: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{promptId}/rags/{ragSystemId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Asociar un RAG System a un Prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<PromptRelationDto>> associateRag(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @PathVariable Long ragSystemId,
            @RequestParam(required = false, defaultValue = "system") String createdBy) {

        log.info("Request to associate RAG system to prompt: promptId={}, ragSystemId={}", promptId, ragSystemId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                PromptRag promptRag = promptBusinessService.associateRag(promptId, ragSystemId, createdBy);
                return toRelationDto(promptRag, "RAG");
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error associating RAG: promptId={}, ragSystemId={}", promptId, ragSystemId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST).build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{promptId}/rags/{ragSystemId}")
    @Operation(summary = "Desasociar un RAG System de un Prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>> disassociateRag(
            @PathVariable Long promptId,
            @PathVariable Long ragSystemId) {

        log.info("Request to disassociate RAG system from prompt: promptId={}, ragSystemId={}", promptId, ragSystemId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                promptBusinessService.disassociateRag(promptId, ragSystemId);
                return null;
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .then(Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok().<Void>build()))
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error disassociating RAG: promptId={}, ragSystemId={}", promptId, ragSystemId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{promptId}/rags")
    @Operation(summary = "Obtener RAG Systems asociados a un Prompt")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<PromptRelationDto>>> getAssociatedRags(@PathVariable Long promptId) {
        log.info("Request to get associated RAG systems: promptId={}", promptId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                List<PromptRag> promptRags = promptBusinessService.getAssociatedRags(promptId);
                return promptRags.stream()
                    .map(pr -> toRelationDto(pr, "RAG"))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting associated RAG systems: promptId={}", promptId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    // ✅ Métodos de conversión DTO ↔ Entidad (OBLIGATORIOS)

    private PromptDto toDto(Prompt entity) {
        PromptDto dto = new PromptDto();
        dto.setIdxprompt(entity.getIdxprompt());
        dto.setPrmuuid(entity.getPrmuuid());
        dto.setPrmname(entity.getPrmname());
        dto.setPrmdescription(entity.getPrmdescription());
        dto.setPrmtype(entity.getPrmtype());
        dto.setPrmcategory(entity.getPrmcategory());
        dto.setPrmversion(entity.getPrmversion());
        dto.setPrmstatus(entity.getPrmstatus());
        dto.setPrmcontent(entity.getPrmcontent());
        dto.setPrmparameters(entity.getPrmparameters());
        dto.setPrmmetadata(entity.getPrmmetadata());
        dto.setPrmapprovalstatus(entity.getPrmapprovalstatus());
        dto.setPrmapprovedby(entity.getPrmapprovedby());
        if (entity.getPrmapprovedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmapprovedat(entity.getPrmapprovedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setPrmcreatedby(entity.getPrmcreatedby());
        dto.setPrmupdatedby(entity.getPrmupdatedby());
        if (entity.getPrmcreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmcreatedat(entity.getPrmcreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        if (entity.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            dto.setPrmupdatedat(entity.getPrmupdatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        return dto;
    }

    private Prompt toEntity(PromptDto dto) {
        Prompt entity = new Prompt();
        if (dto.getIdxprompt() != null) {
            entity.setIdxprompt(dto.getIdxprompt());
        }
        entity.setPrmuuid(dto.getPrmuuid());
        entity.setPrmname(dto.getPrmname());
        entity.setPrmdescription(dto.getPrmdescription());
        entity.setPrmtype(dto.getPrmtype());
        entity.setPrmcategory(dto.getPrmcategory());
        entity.setPrmversion(dto.getPrmversion());
        entity.setPrmstatus(dto.getPrmstatus());
        entity.setPrmcontent(dto.getPrmcontent());
        entity.setPrmparameters(dto.getPrmparameters());
        entity.setPrmmetadata(dto.getPrmmetadata());
        entity.setPrmapprovalstatus(dto.getPrmapprovalstatus());
        entity.setPrmapprovedby(dto.getPrmapprovedby());
        if (dto.getPrmapprovedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmapprovedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmapprovedat()));
        }
        entity.setPrmcreatedby(dto.getPrmcreatedby());
        entity.setPrmupdatedby(dto.getPrmupdatedby());
        if (dto.getPrmcreatedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmcreatedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmcreatedat()));
        } else {
            entity.setPrmcreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        }
        if (dto.getPrmupdatedat() != null) {
            entity.setPrmupdatedat(Timestamp.valueOf(dto.getPrmupdatedat()));
        }
        return entity;
    }

    // Métodos de conversión para relaciones

    private PromptRelationDto toRelationDto(PromptAgent promptAgent, String type) {
        PromptRelationDto dto = new PromptRelationDto();
        dto.setId(promptAgent.getIdxpromptagent());
        dto.setPromptId(promptAgent.getPrompt().getIdxprompt());
        dto.setPromptName(promptAgent.getPrompt().getPrmname());
        dto.setRelatedId(promptAgent.getAgent().getIdxagent());
        // Cargar el nombre del agent si está disponible
        String agentName = promptAgent.getAgent().getAgtname();
        dto.setRelatedName(agentName != null ? agentName : "Agent " + promptAgent.getAgent().getIdxagent());
        dto.setRelatedType(type);
        if (promptAgent.getPrmagtcreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setCreatedAt(promptAgent.getPrmagtcreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setCreatedBy(promptAgent.getPrmagtcreatedby());
        return dto;
    }

    private PromptRelationDto toRelationDto(PromptModel promptModel, String type) {
        PromptRelationDto dto = new PromptRelationDto();
        dto.setId(promptModel.getIdxpromptmodel());
        dto.setPromptId(promptModel.getPrompt().getIdxprompt());
        dto.setPromptName(promptModel.getPrompt().getPrmname());
        dto.setRelatedId(promptModel.getModel().getIdxmodel());
        dto.setRelatedName(promptModel.getModel().getModname());
        dto.setRelatedType(type);
        if (promptModel.getPrmmodcreatedat() != null) {
            dto.setCreatedAt(promptModel.getPrmmodcreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }
        dto.setCreatedBy(promptModel.getPrmmodcreatedby());
        return dto;
    }

    private PromptRelationDto toRelationDto(PromptRag promptRag, String type) {
        PromptRelationDto dto = new PromptRelationDto();
        dto.setId(promptRag.getIdxpromptrag());
        dto.setPromptId(promptRag.getPrompt().getIdxprompt());
        dto.setPromptName(promptRag.getPrompt().getPrmname());
        dto.setRelatedId(promptRag.getRagSystem().getIdxragsystem());

            dto.setCreatedAt(promptRag.getPrmragcreatedat().toLocalDateTime());
        }

        return dto;
    }
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.repository.prompts;

import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.prompts.PromptAgent;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.GenericRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Modifying;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Repositorio para la relación Prompt-Agent.
 */
@Repository
public interface PromptAgentRepository extends GenericRepository<PromptAgent, Long> {

    /**
     * Busca todas las relaciones de un prompt.
     */
    @Query("SELECT pa FROM PromptAgent pa JOIN FETCH pa.prompt JOIN FETCH pa.agent WHERE pa.prompt.idxprompt = :promptId")
    List<PromptAgent> findByPromptId(@Param("promptId") Long promptId);

    /**
     * Busca todas las relaciones de un agent.
     */
    @Query("SELECT pa FROM PromptAgent pa WHERE pa.agent.idxagent = :agentId")
    List<PromptAgent> findByAgentId(@Param("agentId") Long agentId);

    /**
     * Busca una relación específica.
     */
    @Query("SELECT pa FROM PromptAgent pa WHERE pa.prompt.idxprompt = :promptId AND pa.agent.idxagent = :agentId")
    PromptAgent findByPromptIdAndAgentId(@Param("promptId") Long promptId, @Param("agentId") Long agentId);

    /**
     * Verifica si existe una relación.
     */
    @Query("SELECT COUNT(pa) > 0 FROM PromptAgent pa WHERE pa.prompt.idxprompt = :promptId AND pa.agent.idxagent = :agentId")
    boolean existsByPromptIdAndAgentId(@Param("promptId") Long promptId, @Param("agentId") Long agentId);

    /**
     * Elimina una relación específica.
     */
    @Modifying
    @Transactional
    @Query("DELETE FROM PromptAgent pa WHERE pa.prompt.idxprompt = :promptId AND pa.agent.idxagent = :agentId")
    void deleteByPromptIdAndAgentId(@Param("promptId") Long promptId, @Param("agentId") Long agentId);
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

const GATEWAY_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL || "http://localhost:8080";

export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: { id: string } }
) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${GATEWAY_URL}/api/v1/prompts/${params.id}/agents`,
      {
        method: "GET",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Error al obtener agents asociados" },
        { status: response.status }
      );
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error al obtener agents asociados:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Error al obtener agents asociados" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: { id: string } }
) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { agentId, createdBy } = body;

    const response = await fetch(
      `${GATEWAY_URL}/api/v1/prompts/${params.id}/agents/${agentId}?createdBy=${createdBy || "system"}`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Error al asociar agent" },
        { status: response.status }
      );
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error al asociar agent:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Error al asociar agent" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function DELETE(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: { id: string } }
) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const agentId = searchParams.get("agentId");

    if (!agentId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "agentId es requerido" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const response = await fetch(
      `${GATEWAY_URL}/api/v1/prompts/${params.id}/agents/${agentId}`,
      {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Error al desasociar agent" },
        { status: response.status }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error al desasociar agent:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Error al desasociar agent" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: { id: string } }
) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const modelId = searchParams.get("modelId");

    if (!modelId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "modelId es requerido" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const response = await fetch(
      `${GATEWAY_URL}/api/v1/prompts/${params.id}/models/${modelId}`,
      {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Error al desasociar model" },
        { status: response.status }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error al desasociar model:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Error al desasociar model" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

export async function GET(

) {
```

Agregando las traducciones de prompts al index:


```typescript
// Archivo principal de internacionalización - Combina todos los módulos
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { i18nConfig } from "./config";
import { commonTranslations } from "./modules/common";
import { dashboardTranslations } from "./modules/dashboard";
import { governanceTranslations } from "./modules/governance/index";
import { layoutTranslations } from "./modules/layout";
import { authTranslations } from "./modules/auth";
import { coreTranslations } from "./modules/core";
import { servingTranslations } from "./modules/serving";
import { ragTranslations } from "./modules/rag/index";
import { agentsTranslations } from "./modules/agents/index";
import { promptsTranslations } from "./modules/prompts";
import { Language } from "./types";
// Importar otros módulos aquí cuando se creen
// import { complianceTranslations } from "./modules/compliance";
// etc.

// Combinar todas las traducciones
const combineTranslations = (): Record<Language, any> => {
  const languages: Language[] = ["es", "en", "fr", "de", "it", "pt"];

  const combined: Record<string, any> = {};

  languages.forEach((lang) => {
    combined[lang] = {
      common: commonTranslations[lang],
      dashboard: dashboardTranslations[lang],
      governance: governanceTranslations[lang],
      layout: layoutTranslations[lang],
      auth: authTranslations[lang],
      core: coreTranslations[lang],
      serving: servingTranslations[lang],
      rag: ragTranslations[lang],
      agents: agentsTranslations[lang],
      // Añadir otros módulos aquí:
      // compliance: complianceTranslations[lang],
      // etc.
    };
  });

  return combined as Record<Language, any>;
};

export const translations = combineTranslations();

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    try {
      // Intentar obtener el idioma guardado
      const savedLanguage = localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language;

      let validLanguage: Language = "es";

      if (savedLanguage && i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(savedLanguage)) {
        // Si hay un idioma guardado y es válido, usarlo
        validLanguage = savedLanguage;
      } else {
        // Si no hay idioma guardado, detectar el idioma del navegador
        const browserLanguage = navigator.language || (navigator as any).userLanguage;
        const browserLangCode = browserLanguage.split("-")[0] as Language;

        // Si el idioma del navegador está disponible, usarlo
        if (i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(browserLangCode)) {
          validLanguage = browserLangCode;
          // Guardar el idioma detectado
          localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", browserLangCode);
        }
      }

      setLanguageState(validLanguage);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error leyendo idioma de localStorage:", error);
      setLanguageState("es");
    }

    // Escuchar cambios de idioma desde otras pestañas o componentes
    const handleLanguageChange = () => {
      try {
        const savedLanguage =
          (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
        const validLanguage = i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(savedLanguage)
          ? savedLanguage
          : "es";
        setLanguageState((currentLang) => {
          if (validLanguage !== currentLang) {
            return validLanguage;
          }
          return currentLang;
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error leyendo idioma de localStorage:", error);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("languagechange", handleLanguageChange);
    window.addEventListener("storage", handleLanguageChange);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", handleLanguageChange);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", handleLanguageChange);
    };
  }, []); // Remover language de las dependencias para evitar bucle infinito

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language;
      // Validar que el idioma guardado esté en la lista de idiomas disponibles
      if (saved && i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(saved)) {
        return saved;
      }
      return "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (lang: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      // Validar que el idioma esté disponible
      if (!i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(lang)) {
        console.warn(`Idioma ${lang} no está disponible`);
        return;
      }
      // Guardar en localStorage primero
      try {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", lang);
      // Actualizar estado inmediatamente
      setLanguageState(lang);
        // Forzar actualización del DOM inmediatamente
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("languagechange"));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error guardando idioma en localStorage:", error);
      }
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el cambio en todos los componentes
      // Usar un pequeño delay para asegurar que el localStorage se guarde
      setTimeout(() => {
      window.location.reload();
      }, 50);
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    // Usar el estado del idioma actual, no getLanguage()
    const currentLanguage = language;
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match: string, param: string) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: i18nConfig.availableLanguages,
  };
}

// Re-exportar tipos y configuración
export { i18nConfig } from "./config";
export type { I18nConfig, Language } from "./types";
```

```typescript
// Archivo principal de internacionalización - Combina todos los módulos
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { i18nConfig } from "./config";
import { commonTranslations } from "./modules/common";
import { dashboardTranslations } from "./modules/dashboard";
import { governanceTranslations } from "./modules/governance/index";
import { layoutTranslations } from "./modules/layout";
import { authTranslations } from "./modules/auth";
import { coreTranslations } from "./modules/core";
import { servingTranslations } from "./modules/serving";
import { ragTranslations } from "./modules/rag/index";
import { agentsTranslations } from "./modules/agents/index";
import { promptsTranslations } from "./modules/prompts";
import { Language } from "./types";
// Importar otros módulos aquí cuando se creen
// import { complianceTranslations } from "./modules/compliance";
// etc.

// Combinar todas las traducciones
const combineTranslations = (): Record<Language, any> => {
  const languages: Language[] = ["es", "en", "fr", "de", "it", "pt"];

  const combined: Record<string, any> = {};

  languages.forEach((lang) => {
    combined[lang] = {
      common: commonTranslations[lang],
      dashboard: dashboardTranslations[lang],
      governance: governanceTranslations[lang],
      layout: layoutTranslations[lang],
      auth: authTranslations[lang],
      core: coreTranslations[lang],
      serving: servingTranslations[lang],
      rag: ragTranslations[lang],
      agents: agentsTranslations[lang],
      prompts: promptsTranslations[lang],
      // Añadir otros módulos aquí:
      // compliance: complianceTranslations[lang],
      // etc.
    };
  });

  return combined as Record<Language, any>;
};

export const translations = combineTranslations();

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    try {
      // Intentar obtener el idioma guardado
      const savedLanguage = localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language;

      let validLanguage: Language = "es";

      if (savedLanguage && i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(savedLanguage)) {
        // Si hay un idioma guardado y es válido, usarlo
        validLanguage = savedLanguage;
      } else {
        // Si no hay idioma guardado, detectar el idioma del navegador
        const browserLanguage = navigator.language || (navigator as any).userLanguage;
        const browserLangCode = browserLanguage.split("-")[0] as Language;

        // Si el idioma del navegador está disponible, usarlo
        if (i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(browserLangCode)) {
          validLanguage = browserLangCode;
          // Guardar el idioma detectado
          localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", browserLangCode);
        }
      }

      setLanguageState(validLanguage);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error leyendo idioma de localStorage:", error);
      setLanguageState("es");
    }

    // Escuchar cambios de idioma desde otras pestañas o componentes
    const handleLanguageChange = () => {
      try {
        const savedLanguage =
          (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
        const validLanguage = i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(savedLanguage)
          ? savedLanguage
          : "es";
        setLanguageState((currentLang) => {
          if (validLanguage !== currentLang) {
            return validLanguage;
          }
          return currentLang;
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error leyendo idioma de localStorage:", error);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("languagechange", handleLanguageChange);
    window.addEventListener("storage", handleLanguageChange);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", handleLanguageChange);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", handleLanguageChange);
    };
  }, []); // Remover language de las dependencias para evitar bucle infinito

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language;
      // Validar que el idioma guardado esté en la lista de idiomas disponibles
      if (saved && i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(saved)) {
        return saved;
      }
      return "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (lang: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      // Validar que el idioma esté disponible
      if (!i18nConfig.availableLanguages.includes(lang)) {
        console.warn(`Idioma ${lang} no está disponible`);
        return;
      }
      // Guardar en localStorage primero
      try {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", lang);
      // Actualizar estado inmediatamente
      setLanguageState(lang);
        // Forzar actualización del DOM inmediatamente
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("languagechange"));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error guardando idioma en localStorage:", error);
      }
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el cambio en todos los componentes
      // Usar un pequeño delay para asegurar que el localStorage se guarde
      setTimeout(() => {
      window.location.reload();
      }, 50);
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    // Usar el estado del idioma actual, no getLanguage()
    const currentLanguage = language;
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match: string, param: string) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: i18nConfig.availableLanguages,
  };
}

// Re-exportar tipos y configuración
export { i18nConfig } from "./config";
export type { I18nConfig, Language } from "./types";
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Brain, Save, ArrowLeft, FileText, FileCode, X, Plus, Bot, Cpu, Database } from "lucide-react";
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useRouter, usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { CodeEditor } from "@/components/ui/code-editor";
import { getPromptyTemplate } from "@/lib/prompty-template";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

interface PromptFormData {
  prmname: string;
  prmdescription: string;
  prmcontent: string;
  prmparameters: string;
  prmchanges: string;
  prmstatus: string;
  prmversion?: string; // Solo lectura, se muestra pero no se edita
}

export default function PromptRegisterPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [promptId, setPromptId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const originalContentRef = useRef<string>("");
  const [relations, setRelations] = useState<{
    agents: Array<{ id: number; name: string; relationId: number }>;
    models: Array<{ id: number; name: string; relationId: number }>;
    rags: Array<{ id: number; name: string; relationId: number }>;
  }>({
    agents: [],
    models: [],
    rags: [],
  });
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<PromptFormData>({
    prmname: "",
    prmdescription: "",
    prmcontent: "",
    prmparameters: "temperature=0.7, max_tokens=1000",
    prmchanges: "",
    prmstatus: "DRAFT",
    prmversion: "1.0.0", // Versión inicial, se generará automáticamente
  });
  const [showTemplate, setShowTemplate] = useState(false);

  // Detectar si es modo edición
  useEffect(() => {
    const pathParts = pathname.split('/');
    const editIndex = pathParts.findIndex(part => part === 'edit');
    if (editIndex > 0) {
      const id = parseInt(pathParts[editIndex - 1]);
      if (!isNaN(id)) {
        setIsEditMode(true);
        setPromptId(id);
        loadPromptData(id);
      }
    }
  }, [pathname]);

  // Cargar datos del prompt en modo edición
  const loadPromptData = async (id: number) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/governance/prompts/${id}`);
      if (response.ok) {
        const prompt = await response.json();
        setFormData({
          prmname: prompt.name || "",
          prmdescription: prompt.description || "",
          prmcontent: prompt.content || "",
          prmparameters: prompt.parameters || "temperature=0.7, max_tokens=1000",
          prmchanges: "",
          prmstatus: prompt.status || "DRAFT",
          prmversion: prompt.version || "1.0.0",
        });
        originalContentRef.current = prompt.content || "";

        // Cargar relaciones
        loadRelations(id);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error al cargar prompt:", error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Cargar relaciones del prompt
  const loadRelations = async (id: number) => {
    try {
      const [agentsRes, modelsRes, ragsRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`/api/governance/prompts/${id}/agents`),
        fetch(`/api/governance/prompts/${id}/models`),
        fetch(`/api/governance/prompts/${id}/rags`),
      ]);

      const agents = agentsRes.ok ? await agentsRes.json() : [];
      const models = modelsRes.ok ? await modelsRes.json() : [];
      const rags = ragsRes.ok ? await ragsRes.json() : [];

      setRelations({
        agents: agents.map((r: any) => ({ id: r.relatedId, name: r.relatedName, relationId: r.id })),
        models: models.map((r: any) => ({ id: r.relatedId, name: r.relatedName, relationId: r.id })),
        rags: rags.map((r: any) => ({ id: r.relatedId, name: r.relatedName, relationId: r.id })),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error al cargar relaciones:", error);
    }
  };

  // Desasociar relación
  const handleDisassociate = async (type: 'agents' | 'models' | 'rags', relationId: number, relatedId: number) => {
    if (!promptId) return;

    try {
      const endpoint = type === 'agents' ? 'agents' : type === 'models' ? 'models' : 'rags';
      const response = await fetch(`/api/governance/prompts/${promptId}/${endpoint}/${relatedId}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        setRelations(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          [type]: prev[type].filter(r => r.relationId !== relationId),
        }));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`Error al desasociar ${type}:`, error);
    }
  };

  // Cargar plantilla Prompty cuando el usuario la solicite
  const loadPromptyTemplate = () => {
    const template = getPromptyTemplate(formData.prmname || "My New Prompt", formData.prmdescription || "A description for my new prompt.");
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, prmcontent: template }));
    setShowTemplate(true);
  };

  const handleInputChange = (
    field: keyof PromptFormData,
    value: string
  ) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // Si es modo edición y el contenido cambió, crear nueva versión
      const contentChanged = isEditMode && formData.prmcontent !== originalContentRef.current;

      if (isEditMode && contentChanged) {
        // Crear nueva versión automáticamente
        const response = await fetch(`/api/governance/prompts/${promptId}/versions`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            name: formData.prmname,
            description: formData.prmdescription,
            content: formData.prmcontent,
            parameters: formData.prmparameters,
            status: formData.prmstatus,
            changes: formData.prmchanges || "Actualización automática: contenido modificado",
          }),
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("Error al crear nueva versión");
        }
      } else if (isEditMode) {
        // Actualizar sin crear nueva versión (solo metadata)
        const response = await fetch(`/api/governance/prompts/${promptId}`, {
          method: "PUT",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            name: formData.prmname,
            description: formData.prmdescription,
            parameters: formData.prmparameters,
            status: formData.prmstatus,
          }),
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("Error al actualizar el prompt");
        }
      } else {
        // Crear nuevo prompt
        const response = await fetch("/api/governance/prompts", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            name: formData.prmname,
            description: formData.prmdescription,
            content: formData.prmcontent,
            parameters: formData.prmparameters,
            status: formData.prmstatus,
            changes: formData.prmchanges,
          }),
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("Error al registrar el prompt");
        }
      }

      // Redirigir a la página principal de prompts después de guardar
      router.push("/governance/prompts");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error al guardar prompt:", error);
      alert(t("governance.prompts.register.error", "Error al guardar el prompt"));
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    router.back();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
          <Brain className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
            {t("prompts.register.title", "Registrar Nuevo Prompt")}
          </h1>
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
          {t(
            "governance.prompts.register.subtitle",
            "Crea y registra un nuevo prompt de IA"
          )}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Formulario */}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <CardTitle>
                {t("governance.prompts.register.form.title", "Información del Prompt")}
              </CardTitle>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={handleCancel}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                >
                  <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.cancel", "Cancelar")}
                </Button>
                <Button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
                  <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {isSubmitting
                    ? t("governance.prompts.register.form.saving", "Guardando...")
                    : t("governance.prompts.register.form.save", "Guardar Prompt")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            {/* Primera fila: Nombre, Versión y Estado */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {/* Nombre */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="prmname">
                  {t("governance.prompts.register.form.name", "Nombre")}
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="prmname"
                  value={formData.prmname}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleInputChange("prmname", e.target.value)
                  }
                  placeholder={t(
                    "governance.prompts.register.form.namePlaceholder",
                    "Nombre del prompt"
                  )}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Versión (solo lectura) */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <Label htmlFor="prmversion">
                    {t("governance.prompts.register.form.version", "Versión")}
                  </Label>
                  {isEditMode && (
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => window.location.href = "/governance/prompts/versioning/overview"}
                      className="text-xs h-auto py-1 px-2"
                    >
                      {t("governance.prompts.register.form.viewVersions", "Ver Versiones")}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <Input
                  id="prmversion"
                  value={formData.prmversion || "1.0.0"}
                  readOnly
                  disabled
                  className="bg-muted cursor-not-allowed"
                />
                {isEditMode && formData.prmcontent !== originalContentRef.current && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                    {t("governance.prompts.register.form.newVersionWarning", "⚠ Se creará una nueva versión al guardar porque el contenido ha cambiado")}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Estado */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="prmstatus">
                  {t("governance.prompts.register.form.status", "Estado")}
                </Label>
                <Select
                  value={formData.prmstatus}
                  onValueChange={(value) => handleInputChange("prmstatus", value)}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger id="prmstatus">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="DRAFT">
                      {t("governance.prompts.register.form.status.draft", "Borrador")}
                    </SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="ACTIVE">
                      {t("governance.prompts.register.form.status.active", "Activo")}
                    </SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="INACTIVE">
                      {t("governance.prompts.register.form.status.inactive", "Inactivo")}
                    </SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Segunda fila: Descripción (35%), Cambios (35%), Parámetros (30%) */}
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4">
              {/* Descripción */}
              <div className="space-y-2 flex-1" style={{ flex: '0 0 35%' }}>
                <Label htmlFor="prmdescription">
                  {t("governance.prompts.register.form.description", "Descripción")}
                </Label>
                <Textarea
                  id="prmdescription"
                  value={formData.prmdescription}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleInputChange("prmdescription", e.target.value)
                  }
                  placeholder={t(
                    "governance.prompts.register.form.descriptionPlaceholder",
                    "Descripción detallada del prompt"
                  )}
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Cambios/Notas */}
              <div className="space-y-2 flex-1" style={{ flex: '0 0 35%' }}>
                <Label htmlFor="prmchanges">
                  {t("governance.prompts.register.form.changes", "Cambios / Notas")}
                </Label>
                <Textarea
                  id="prmchanges"
                  value={formData.prmchanges}
                  onChange={(e) => handleInputChange("prmchanges", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={t(
                    "governance.prompts.register.form.changesPlaceholder",
                    "Notas sobre los cambios o características de esta versión..."
                  )}
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Parámetros */}
              <div className="space-y-2 flex-1" style={{ flex: '0 0 30%' }}>
                <Label htmlFor="prmparameters">
                  {t("governance.prompts.register.form.parameters", "Parámetros")}
                </Label>
                <Textarea
                  id="prmparameters"
                  value={formData.prmparameters}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleInputChange("prmparameters", e.target.value)
                  }
                  placeholder="temperature=0.7, max_tokens=1000"
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full"
                  required
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Contenido del Prompt con Editor de Código */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <Label htmlFor="prmcontent">
                  {t("governance.prompts.register.form.content", "Contenido del Prompt")}
                </Label>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={loadPromptyTemplate}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2"
                >
                  <FileCode className="w-4 h-4" />
                  {t("governance.prompts.register.form.loadTemplate", "Cargar Plantilla")}
                </Button>
              </div>
              <CodeEditor
                value={formData.prmcontent}
                onChange={(value) => handleInputChange("prmcontent", value || "")}
                language="markdown"
                height="400px"
                placeholder={t(
                  "governance.prompts.register.form.contentPlaceholder",
                  "Escribe el contenido del prompt aquí... Usa el formato Prompty para una estructura profesional."
                )}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Relaciones (solo en modo edición) */}
            {isEditMode && promptId && (
              <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">
                    {t("governance.prompts.register.form.relations", "Relaciones")}
                  </h3>
                  
                  {/* Agents */}
                  <div className="space-y-2 mb-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <Label className="text-sm">
                        {t("governance.prompts.register.form.agents", "Agents")}
                      </Label>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {relations.agents.length === 0 ? (
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("governance.prompts.register.form.noAgents", "No hay agents asociados")}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        relations.agents.map((agent) => (
                          <Badge key={agent.relationId} variant="secondary" className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            {agent.name}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleDisassociate('agents', agent.relationId, agent.id)}
                              className="ml-1 hover:bg-destructive/20 rounded-full p-0.5"
                            >
                              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                            </button>
                          </Badge>
                        ))
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Models */}
                  <div className="space-y-2 mb-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <Label className="text-sm">
                        {t("governance.prompts.register.form.models", "Models")}
                      </Label>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {relations.models.length === 0 ? (
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("governance.prompts.register.form.noModels", "No hay models asociados")}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        relations.models.map((model) => (
                          <Badge key={model.relationId} variant="secondary" className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            {model.name}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleDisassociate('models', model.relationId, model.id)}
                              className="ml-1 hover:bg-destructive/20 rounded-full p-0.5"
                            >
                              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                            </button>
                          </Badge>
                        ))
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* RAG Systems */}
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Database className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <Label className="text-sm">
                        {t("governance.prompts.register.form.rags", "RAG Systems")}
                      </Label>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {relations.rags.length === 0 ? (
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("governance.prompts.register.form.noRags", "No hay RAG systems asociados")}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        relations.rags.map((rag) => (
                          <Badge key={rag.relationId} variant="secondary" className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            {rag.name}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleDisassociate('rags', rag.relationId, rag.id)}
                              className="ml-1 hover:bg-destructive/20 rounded-full p-0.5"
                            >
                              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                            </button>
                          </Badge>
                        ))
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```
